runewords.Name: Maelstrom
runewords.Flavour: The storm turns, and everything near it burns.

runewords.Name: Earthbreaker

Mods.Text: Every fourth Slam breaks the ground: 3 spikes erupt within 3.5 metres for 50% of its hit as Fire damage

runewords.Flavour: Strike the earth four times, and the fifth time it answers.

runewords.Name: Ram's Vow
runewords.Flavour: Lower the shield. Do not stop.

runewords.Name: Stormcaller
runewords.Flavour: The bolt finds one, then the two beside him.

runewords.Name: Skyfire
runewords.Flavour: The sky pays back each fire you lit.

runewords.Name: Cinderwind
runewords.Flavour: Ash rides the wind further than flame.

runewords.Name: Siegeworks

Mods.Text: Ballistas fire an additional bolt

runewords.Flavour: Build the wall of bolts, then stand behind it.

runewords.Name: Hailstorm
runewords.Flavour: Every arrow comes down as ice.

runewords.Name: Spiderweb
runewords.Flavour: Pull one thread, and the whole web sings.

runewords.Name: Petalfall

Mods.Text: Thousand Cuts hits have a 20% chance to bring down 2 falling blades within 1.1 metres of the enemy struck for 40% of the hit (at most once every 0.6 seconds)

runewords.Flavour: The blossoms fall where the blade has been.

runewords.Name: Whirling Steel
runewords.Flavour: Steel that never lands, never stops.

runewords.Name: Iaido
runewords.Flavour: The sword is drawn once.

runewords.Name: Hammerfall

Mods.Text: +2 orbiting projectiles per cast (Blade Vortex, Orbiting Hammers and the Orbit support)
Orbit skills circle 20% wider (Orbiting Hammers and Blade Vortex)
+1 more orbiting projectile per cast (Blade Vortex, Orbiting Hammers and the Orbit support)

runewords.Flavour: The hammers circle wider for the faithful.

runewords.Name: Verdict

Mods.Text: 30% increased Holy Damage

runewords.Flavour: Judgement waits for no one.

runewords.Name: Choir
runewords.Flavour: Every voice that falls is answered by two.

runewords.Name: Ashen Legion

Mods.Text: Your Minions' damage is 30% converted to Fire

runewords.Flavour: They march to the pyre, and the pyre marches with them.

runewords.Name: Harvest
runewords.Flavour: The field is wide. The scythe is patient.

runewords.Name: Plague Wind
runewords.Flavour: What the wind carries, the grave keeps.

runewords.Name: Wayfarer
runewords.Flavour: The road is shorter if you don't stop.

runewords.Name: Kindling
runewords.Flavour: A spark is a fortune if you feed it.

runewords.Name: Bulwark
runewords.Flavour: Stand. That is the whole of the oath.

runewords.Name: Warding
runewords.Flavour: Fire, frost and storm, each one turned aside.

runewords.Name: Wellspring
runewords.Flavour: Drink, and the well fills again.

runewords.Name: Dragon's Hoard
runewords.Flavour: Dwarven gold. Kept, not counted.

runewords.Name: Sunder
runewords.Flavour: No ward holds against the three.

runewords.Name: Oathkeeper
runewords.Flavour: Some oaths are older than the ones who swore them.

runewords.Name: Thunderwake
runewords.Flavour: Where the hammer lands, thunder follows.

runewords.Name: Gravebloom
runewords.Flavour: What is buried in ash comes up burning.

runewords.Name: Windrider
runewords.Flavour: Not where the blade expected you.

runewords.Name: Glacier's Oath
runewords.Flavour: The ice keeps every promise made to it.

runewords.Name: Ironchoir
runewords.Flavour: The dead sing the hymns the living forgot.

runewords.Name: Bladesong
runewords.Flavour: Steel that learns to sing holds the tune.

runewords.Name: Starfall
runewords.Flavour: Every arrow a falling star.

runewords.Name: First Light
runewords.Flavour: The first light after the long night belongs to whoever kept watch.

runewords.Name: Skybinder
runewords.Flavour: The cloud does not ask where the lightning goes.

runewords.Name: Nightshade
runewords.Flavour: Pretty in the hedgerow. Patient in the blood.

runewords.Name: Heartseeker
runewords.Flavour: One arrow, drawn slow, loosed once.

runewords.Name: Swallowcut
runewords.Flavour: The blade turns in the air like a swallow, and cuts on the way back.

runewords.Name: Rimebinder
runewords.Flavour: Frost waits where you will stand.

runewords.Name: Ossuary

Mods.Text: Your Minions' damage is 30% converted to Cold

runewords.Flavour: The learned dead still know their lessons, and teach them coldly.

runewords.Name: Bloodletter
runewords.Flavour: A shallow cut, and then another.

runewords.Name: Dawnsworn

Mods.Text: 35% increased Holy Damage

runewords.Flavour: Raised at first light, and it has not been lowered since.

runewords.Name: Emberwake
runewords.Flavour: What it touches burns long after it has gone.

runewords.Name: Stormlash
runewords.Flavour: The first strike finds you. The second was waiting.

runewords.Name: Clarion

Mods.Text: 25% increased effect of the extra Damage your Heralds grant

runewords.Flavour: Every hall it enters already knows its name.

runewords.Name: Kindlewatch

Mods.Text: +1 to the level of Spark gems

runewords.Flavour: Light a fire, then let it stand watch.

runewords.Name: Stillwater
runewords.Flavour: Winter comes. The lake holds.

runewords.Name: Viperstring
runewords.Flavour: One arrow, and time.

runewords.Name: Oathwall

Mods.Text: 0.27% more Damage for every 1,000 Armour you have. No diminishing returns.

runewords.Flavour: The heavier the wall, the harder it lands.

runewords.Name: Veilward

Mods.Text: 0.33% more Damage for every 1,000 maximum Energy Shield you have. No diminishing returns.

runewords.Flavour: What cannot touch me cannot stop me.

runewords.Name: Ouroboros

Mods.Text: When a chain ends, it starts again from the last target with its full chain count, once per cast

runewords.Flavour: The serpent bites its tail, and the storm begins again.

runewords.Name: Barrowking's Mandate

Mods.Text: A minion that dies rises once as a spectral copy for 10 seconds with 100% more Damage

runewords.Flavour: The barrow keeps no one. It lends them back.

runewords.Name: Engine of the Deep

Mods.Text: Each totem builds a copy of itself every 6 seconds; copies last 12 seconds

runewords.Flavour: Stone raises stone, and the deep is never finished.

runewords.Name: Skyspear
runewords.Flavour: One spear leaves the hand. The sky returns a hundred.

runewords.Name: Pyre of Kings

Mods.Text: Every fifth Slam erupts again: a fire spike strikes the nearest enemy within 4.5 metres for 300% of its hit as Fire damage

runewords.Flavour: Kings were burned on oak. The oak remembers how.

runewords.Name: Orbit of Ash

Mods.Text: Orbiting hits on a Guardian release a Lightning nova for 250% of the hit (every 0.3 seconds, 3 metre radius)

runewords.Flavour: The ash tree turns, and the storm turns with it.

runewords.Name: Thousand Hands
runewords.Flavour: A thousand hands draw. None of them are yours.

runewords.Name: Stormwake

Mods.Text: Every hit, and every chain hop, bursts in a Lightning nova for 60% of that hit (2.5 metre radius; each enemy at most once every 0.2 seconds)

runewords.Flavour: The storm strikes, then follows.
